import Mathlib

structure BFSGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def BFSGraph.well_formed (g : BFSGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def BFSGraph.size (g : BFSGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def BFSGraph.has_edge (g : BFSGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def BFSGraph.is_path (g : BFSGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def BFSGraph.reachable (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target

def BFSGraph.is_shortest_distance (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ p.length = d + 1) ∧
  (∀ p, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → p.length ≥ d + 1)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bfs_shortest_path_precond (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ graph.size ≤ 10000 ∧ start < graph.size ∧ target < graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
noncomputable section

def BFSGraph.exists_distance (g : BFSGraph) (start target d : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ p.length = d + 1

theorem BFSGraph.reachable_exists_distance (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h : g.reachable start target) :
    ∃ d, g.exists_distance start target d := by
  rcases h with ⟨p, hp, hhead, hlast⟩
  refine ⟨p.length - 1, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨p, hp, hhead, hlast, ?_⟩
  have hle : 1 ≤ p.length := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hp.1
  exact (Nat.sub_add_cancel hle).symm

def BFSGraph.shortestDistance (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h : g.reachable start target) : Nat :=
  @Nat.find (fun d => g.exists_distance start target d)
    (Classical.decPred (fun d => g.exists_distance start target d))
    (BFSGraph.reachable_exists_distance g start target h)

theorem BFSGraph.shortestDistance_exists (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h : g.reachable start target) :
    g.exists_distance start target (g.shortestDistance start target h) := by
  classical
  simpa [BFSGraph.shortestDistance] using
    (Nat.find_spec (BFSGraph.reachable_exists_distance g start target h))

theorem BFSGraph.shortestDistance_min (g : BFSGraph) (start target d : Nat)
    (h : g.reachable start target)
    (hd : g.exists_distance start target d) :
    g.shortestDistance start target h ≤ d := by
  classical
  simpa [BFSGraph.shortestDistance] using
    (Nat.find_min' (BFSGraph.reachable_exists_distance g start target h) hd)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bfs_shortest_path (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) : Option Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  by
    classical
    if h : graph.reachable start target then
      exact some (graph.shortestDistance start target h)
    else
      exact none
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bfs_shortest_path_postcond (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (result : Option Nat)
    (_ : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dist => graph.is_shortest_distance start target dist
  | none => ¬ graph.reachable start target
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
end
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem bfs_shortest_path_postcond_satisfied (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) :
    bfs_shortest_path_postcond graph start target
      (bfs_shortest_path graph start target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  classical
  unfold bfs_shortest_path
  split
  · rename_i hreach
    change graph.is_shortest_distance start target
      (graph.shortestDistance start target hreach)

      rw [hklen]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ hmin
  · rename_i hnreach
    change ¬ graph.reachable start target
    exact hnreach
  -- !benchmark @end proof
